scope: The eleven captured python/example scripts without a main guard, at this exact revision
review_kind: Static original-source entry and operational-requirement review; no script execution
native_provider: The exact AuroraClient and MoveCommandManager implementation/runtime remains a required external dependency. The authored ROS bridge is a distinct adapter, not the original native SDK.
variant_policy: Keep exact model/path identities and group related stems; do not add model variants to a separate unique-algorithm count.

demo_joint_command.purpose: Interactive complete grouped-joint PD configuration and two interpolated position moves
demo_joint_command.entry_evidence: Module-level AuroraClient.get_instance followed by input gates, state/configuration calls, interpolation loops and client.close
preservation_requirements: The selected robot_name, domain_id123, FSM10 and original interactive ordering
Every model-specific kp/kd vector, its group keys and complete gain readback
All current/target/zero joint arrays and their exact model-specific lengths
Both inclusive0..200 interpolation loops with0.01-second explicit native cadence
Final complete group reads and software close; no generic scalar message substitution
An explicit bounded scheduling/timeout adaptation with unknown delivery retained and no automatic replay
demo_joint_command.original_cleanup: client.close on normal completion; no general exception-finally cleanup in this source

demo_motion_command.purpose: Interactive FSM, stand-pose, velocity-source and timed multi-segment locomotion commands
demo_motion_command.entry_evidence: Module-level client construction and directly invoked native commands, sleeps and input gates
preservation_requirements: FSM2, stand-pose adjustment/readback/reset, then FSM3 and velocity source2 in original order
Complete three-component stand-pose and velocity values, each explicit duration and all input gates
Forward and lateral0.2m/s segments and0.4rad/s yaw segment for5 seconds each, followed by the explicit zero-velocity1-second segment
The original native call/result model and timing; preparing a request or publishing one record is not this whole program
Explicit software cleanup and bounded cancellation/timeout behavior without claiming a physical stop
demo_motion_command.original_cleanup: client.close on normal completion; no general exception-finally cleanup in this source

demo_robot_status.purpose: Repeated complete base/contact/joint/cartesian observations with formatted status output
demo_robot_status.entry_evidence: Module-level client construction and a try/while loop; KeyboardInterrupt handler closes the client
preservation_requirements: Both rpy and world-velocity reads, the complete contact-probability vector and the strict probability>0.5 display rule
The complete left-manipulator joint vector and cartesian pose; preserve source joint count and first-three-position display
Original timestamp/status presentation and0.5-second polling cadence as explicit scheduler inputs
KeyboardInterrupt-equivalent local termination and checked software cleanup; a bounded port must expose its termination condition
No observation-only program gains command authority or fabricates native values
demo_robot_status.original_cleanup: client.close only in the KeyboardInterrupt handler; other exceptions have no cleanup guarantee in this source

demo_move_command.purpose: Cooperating AuroraClient and MoveCommandManager for joint, cartesian-joint and cartesian-line moves with completion waits
demo_move_command.entry_evidence: Both native owners are constructed at module level; three command batches and completion waits are directly invoked
preservation_requirements: Both selected model owners, FSM3 then upper FSM4, original input gates and occupied group set
Every complete model-specific left/right arm target and all seven cartesian pose components
Move type0 joint, type1 cartesian-joint and type2 cartesian-line batches with original expect_vel300 native units
Manager get_move_command, client set_move_command and wait_groups_motion_complete cooperation for each batch
Original readbacks,0.3-second wait print interval and complete status/error behavior
A separately bounded completion-wait adaptation must preserve unknown outcomes; no timeout-triggered replay or fabricated completion
demo_move_command.original_cleanup: client.close on normal completion; the manager has no explicit close call here and exceptions have no finally cleanup
